title: Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) Troubleshooting
description: Fix missing field groups, values not saving, REST/API exposure issues, and ACF Pro license problems.

steps.title: Identify the ACF Symptom
steps.instructions: Determine if field groups are missing in admin, values not saving on save, fields empty on the front end, or JSON sync out of date after deploy.

steps.title: Review Field Group Location Rules
steps.instructions: Open ACF → Field Groups and confirm location rules match the post type, page template, or taxonomy. A single wrong rule hides the entire group.

steps.title: Sync Local JSON Field Groups
steps.instructions: If using acf-json in the theme, check ACF → Tools → Sync for available updates. Deploy theme JSON files before expecting fields on staging/production.

steps.title: Check for Save Hook Conflicts
steps.instructions: Other plugins or theme code hooking save_post can prevent meta from saving. Temporarily disable custom save hooks and test if ACF values persist.

steps.title: Verify get_field() and Template Usage
steps.instructions: Confirm field names match (no typos). Use the second parameter for post ID on archives. For options pages, use 'option' as the post_id.

steps.title: Enable REST API Exposure if Needed
steps.instructions: For headless or block editor use, enable 'Show in REST API' on field groups. Verify fields appear in /wp/v2/{post_type} responses.

steps.title: Verify ACF Pro License and Updates
steps.instructions: Expired licenses block Pro updates and can cause compatibility issues on new WordPress versions. Re-activate the license under Plugins or ACF settings.

steps.title: Test Save and Front-End Display
steps.instructions: Edit a post with ACF fields, save, reload admin, and confirm values on the front end. Repeat on staging after any JSON sync or deploy.
